title: Todo List Application
description: An application to manage and organize tasks efficiently.

features.name: Task Creation
features.description: Allows users to create new tasks with titles and descriptions.

features.name: Task Editing
features.description: Enables users to edit existing tasks to update details.

features.name: Task Deletion
features.description: Provides functionality to delete tasks that are no longer needed.

features.name: Task Prioritization
features.description: Allows users to set priority levels for tasks to manage them effectively.

features.name: Task Completion
features.description: Enables users to mark tasks as completed.

target_users: Individuals looking to manage their tasks and improve productivity
data_requirements: Requires storage for task details including titles, descriptions, and priority levels
